name: reliant-forge-deploy
description: Deploy a static site, a Vite or Next.js static export, or a Go API with Postgres to a live URL with no account. Your user gets a claim link to keep it.

interface.shortDescription: Put a site or a Go + Postgres API online with no account
interface.longDescription: Deploys a static site, a Vite app, a Next.js static export, or a new Go API with Postgres to Reliant hosting with forge env deploy prod --claimable. No account, token or card: it prints a live URL and a claim link the user opens within 72 hours to keep the deploy. Unclaimed backends have no outbound internet until claimed.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this site and give me a URL.
I need a Go API with a database, hosted.
